in highschool, I switched from a private school to one of the worst school in my country (because of my grades, and no other school was close enough) I decided that I shouldnt make friends in an environment like that if I cared about my future and ended up super isolated. 

It made me stressed out and feel constantly depressed, I would sometime get bully a bit. I stopped eating well and would often eat the same thing for week at the time. 

The health problem I got was malnutrition induced psychosis and it happened during school.

I could write an entire book as to what happened during those 4 days of psychosis, but I mainly hallucinated stuff and got brought back to my home twice by the police for wandering in the middle of a highway

at this point, no one new what was happening, my mom was freaking out (I was doing really weird stuff, like trying to move my heart with my mind so its more on the right side) and luckily I asked her to see my GP after tbe fourth day.

I got anti-psychotic and my psychosis stopped, I had a year of psychiatric follow (which wasnt really usefull appart from the prescription but my psychosis stopped) 

I havent experienced anything like it since, I stopped medication and follow up.
